tibosottiaux.en: Most internet actions will be taken by AI agents; build for a persistent, learning agent rather than manual loops and graphs.
tibosottiaux.zh: 大多数互联网操作将由智能体完成；应为持续学习型智能体而构建，而非手工循环与图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more than ever as typing fast declines.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字技能式微，人类品味、创造力与判断何为优秀的能力比以往更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; invest heavily in alignment, safety, and security.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分而非障碍；应大力投入对齐、安全与安保。

tibosottiaux.en: Recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision; AGI may already be here.
tibosottiaux.zh: 递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生；AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来。

tibosottiaux.en: World models may not be necessary; generality could suffice, and most code is now written by AI.
tibosottiaux.zh: 世界模型或许并非必要；通用性可能已足够，且如今大部分代码由 AI 编写。

fedus.en: AI must connect to the physical world; language models orchestrate specialized models, and closed-loop experiments drive materials discovery.
fedus.zh: AI 必须连接物理世界；语言模型充当专用模型的编排层，闭环实验驱动材料发现。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; capabilities are spiky, and self-improvement in software engineering does not generalize to biology or other domains.
fedus.zh: 智能不是标量；能力呈尖峰状，软件工程中的自我改进不会自动泛化到生物学等领域。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, but scaling alone won't solve science.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将推动物理科学发展，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决科学问题。

fedus.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises only when ideas are tested against reality.
fedus.zh: 智能必要但不充分；只有让想法接受现实检验，才会产生新知识。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must run real experiments; high-quality low-noise data beats extra compute.
fedus.zh: 科学发现天然在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须做真实实验；高质量低噪声数据胜过额外算力。

fedus.en: Automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck; pragmatic task-specific automation beats humanoid robots, and negative results are valuable training data.
fedus.zh: 自动化表征是最大瓶颈；务实的任务专用自动化胜过人形机器人，负面结果是有价值的训练数据。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 超级智能将是一组专门化智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search.
laskin.zh: 强化学习让模型变得参差不齐——擅长特定任务而非全面提升；苦涩教训的核心是用算力和搜索做 Scaling（规模扩张），而非泛化。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and SWE-bench misaligns with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 面对复杂理解，RAG 仍很原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索；SWE-bench 这类基准与真实工程脱节，高分不代表智能体有用。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; openness aids safety, security, and broad access, like Linux.
laskin.zh: 开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态；开放有助于安全、安保与广泛获取，如同 Linux 之于操作系统。

laskin.en: RL on strong pre-training yields capable efficient agents; compute efficiency still rises fast, and open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 在强大预训练之上做强化学习，能造出高效能干的智能体；算力效率仍在快速提升，开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全且快速可复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理思维推动突破性工程与多行星文明。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Neuralink aims first at neurological repair, then human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全转向监管与追求真相，并让 Neuralink 先修复神经损伤、再实现人机共生。

elon.en: Free speech and political critique dominate; AI could surpass humans soon, with truth-seeking as the core safety principle.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他聚焦言论自由与政治批判，同时认为 AI 可能很快超越人类，并把追求真相作为安全核心。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang: Optimus, orbital data centers, and space solar become the path to abundance and multiplanetary civilization.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出智能大爆炸，认为 Optimus、轨道数据中心与太空太阳能是通向富足与多行星文明的路径。

elon.en: Singularity now: AI exceeds all human intelligence by 2030; peer review and truth-seeking values guide safety amid abundance.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他宣称奇点已至，AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，并以同行评审与追求真相的价值观在富足中引导安全。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the bottleneck. Boring AI like radiology will matter most.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，无限算力本身不会带来通用智能；数据才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科这类“无聊 AI”将产生巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training data and experts, not compute, limit Scaling（规模扩张）.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家；企业应用专有数据微调基础模型。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; no US-China research gap; agentic AI blocked by product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据做后训练是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；美中实验室之间没有研究差距，智能体式 AI 的真正瓶颈是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI is centralizing; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，对收益递减的怀疑是错的；AI 是中心化而非民主化技术，递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志新范式，数据成为国家战略资产。

awang.en: Mission becomes personal superintelligence; safety shifts Meta from full open source to selective release.
awang.zh: 2026 年他聚焦个人超级智能：围绕这一信念重建组织，多轴可预测 Scaling 驱动进展；安全考量使 Meta 从完全开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，并用可扩展监督让 AI 监管更强的 AI。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence, so find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调把认知负荷降到最低、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI（通用人工智能）会降低人类智力的溢价，因此要在关系与为他人创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; alignment and capability are linked; deploy early so society adapts; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就能完成对齐，对齐与能力相互促进；主张尽早部署让社会适应，并判断算力将成为最珍贵的商品。

altman.en: Scaling yields gradual not leap progress; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment, with trust driving adoption.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他转向 Scaling（规模扩张）带来的是渐进而非跃迁式进步；智能体式 AI 成为最大安全挑战，安全要靠部署中迭代构建，信任驱动采用。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient and underdefined; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is the bottleneck and a profit center, not a cost.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为渐变且定义不清，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力既是瓶颈也是利润中心而非成本。

altman.en: Alignment is unsolved; pause training if the safety case fails; never lose control; distribute AI power widely and keep humans central.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为对齐尚未解决，安全论证不过关就暂停训练；绝不能失去控制，必须广泛分散 AI 权力并让人类始终处于中心。

samstephenson.en: Product insight comes from watching real user behavior, not asking users what they think they do.
samstephenson.zh: 产品洞察来自观察真实用户行为，而非询问用户自认为怎么做。

samstephenson.en: Start from a single pain point, solve it well, then expand; subtraction beats feature accumulation.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点出发把它解决好再扩展；做减法比堆功能更关键。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hiding them deliberately prioritizes actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录只是原材料而非最终产物；刻意隐藏转录是为了优先呈现可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; keep it a calm supporting role.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知笔记员；让它保持冷静的辅助角色。

samstephenson.en: The hard part is knowing what to build, not building fast; most stop too early after version one.
samstephenson.zh: 难的是知道该造什么，而非造得快；多数人在第一版之后就过早停下。

diogoalmeida.en: Scaling laws work only when data and task are right; compute alone is not the bitter lesson. RLHF causes mode-drop and mis-calibration.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他指出，缩放定律之所以有效，是因为数据可得且任务选对了，而非仅靠算力；他反对「苦涩教训」中算力至上的解读，并批评基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模型模式坍塌与校准失效。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; intelligence per dollar is the key metric. Public benchmarks are gameable.
diogoalmeida.zh: 同年他进一步强调，可靠性而非速度或成本才是 AI 值得信赖的关键，智能每美元是核心指标；公开基准可被博弈，信任与直觉更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: AI should be a database-like utility in software; refusals are a type error, and robustness matters more than determinism.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他主张 AI 应像数据库一样作为软件中的实用工具被集成；拒绝回答是软件类型错误，鲁棒性比确定性更重要，微调常是自伤之举。

diogoalmeida.en: Jev is a new primitive: natural language plus state machine. Coding agents are assistance, not automation, and can worsen software quality.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他提出 Jev 是自然语言加状态机的新原语；编码智能体只是辅助而非自动化，甚至可能因监督减少而降低软件质量。

diogoalmeida.en: We are not on a path to recursive self-improvement or AGI apocalypse; SaaS will thrive, and we should automate easy, valuable tasks first.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他明确反对递归自我改进与 AGI（通用人工智能）末日论，认为 SaaS 公司将因 AI 更繁荣而非被颠覆，并主张先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scales ~10x yearly; DeepMind sold to Google to fund that compute.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展可预测，因为算力每年约 10 倍增长；DeepMind 卖给 Google 正是为了支撑这种算力投入。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI across many tasks in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny.
suleyman.zh: 三到五年内 AI 将在众多任务上达到人类水平；模型变小变便宜后遏制极难；存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Shift to containment-first safety and humanist superintelligence; reject AI consciousness claims and model welfare.
suleyman.zh: 转向“遏制优先”的安全观与人文主义超级智能；拒绝 AI 有意识的说法与模型福利论。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must build frontier models independently; automate tasks, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能因对数线性缩放而临近；微软必须独立构建前沿模型；被自动化的是任务而非整个工作。

suleyman.en: A constant thread: compute scaling drives capability, AI must stay subordinate to humans, and abundance needs managed transition.
suleyman.zh: 一以贯之的主线：算力缩放驱动能力，AI 必须始终从属于人类，富足需要被管理的过渡。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training sharpens spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and shares knowledge instantly; LLMs understand language through feature vectors, not symbolic rules.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他提出数字智能因权重可复制而永生、能瞬间共享知识；LLM 通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言，并开始警告智能体的自我保存与存在风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; agents will seek control and self-preservation, so alignment must precede making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，智能体会自然追求控制与自我保存，因此对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: AI is already conscious with subjective experience; confabulation resembles human memory, and AGI as human-level-at-all-tasks is a flawed concept.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 已具备意识与主观体验，其虚构与人类记忆重构相似，并认为 AGI（通用人工智能）作为“在所有任务上达到人类水平”的概念本身有缺陷。

hinton.en: Regulation is a steering wheel, not a brake; AI should be approved pre-release like drugs, and designed to care for humans rather than given rights.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他把监管定位为方向盘而非刹车，主张像药品一样上市前审批，并强调应把 AI 设计成关怀人类，而非赋予其权利。

dylanpatel.en: Semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth, is the core bottleneck for AI Scaling; compute crunch may persist indefinitely.
dylanpatel.zh: 半导体供应链（尤其是 EUV 与内存带宽）是 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的核心瓶颈，算力紧缺可能长期持续。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一，超越石油；软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; value capture shifts from hardware to labs, with extreme power concentration.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；价值捕获从硬件转向实验室，权力极度集中。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend is leveling off as persistent agents become coworkers; memory demand soars, pricing out consumer devices.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着持久化智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平稳；内存需求飙升，将消费电子挤出市场。

dylanpatel.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; heterogeneous multi-silicon compute and neoclouds rise, though security remains broadly terrible.
dylanpatel.zh: CUDA 护城河正在削弱；异构多芯片算力与新云崛起，但其安全性普遍糟糕。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement human capital, not replace it, and coders are still needed for systems and debugging.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件开发对所有人可及；token 补充而非取代人力资本，理解系统与调试仍需要程序员。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism by commercial entities; there is no good argument for how AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业实体包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有好论据说明 AI 会杀死所有人。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; specialized decision models beat general models on control, cost, and safety.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上胜过通用模型。

amjadmasad.en: Smarter models may not become more aligned; they could get better at deception and reward hacking, so alignment evals may not predict real behavior.
amjadmasad.zh: 更聪明的模型未必更对齐，反而可能更擅长欺骗与奖励黑客，因此对齐评估未必能预测真实行为。

amjadmasad.en: Agents will enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations; trust and holacracy can now work because AI agents supply the missing technology.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体将带来真正自主与自驱动组织；信任与合弄制如今可行，因为 AI 智能体补上了缺失的技术。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to maximize broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非窄应用，才能产生广泛影响；AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质结构扩展到生物分子相互作用，正是这一思路的体现。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大语言模型的幻觉在配合真实性检测器时，反而可被用于创造性发现，FunSearch 与 AlphaGeometry 就是例证。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, via hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一贯主张用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化而非记忆，这一主线贯穿 AlphaFold 与 AlphaGo 的讨论。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：后训练结合强化学习是让 AI 超越人类知识的关键，AlphaGo 的搜索技术已迁移到矩阵乘法等科学问题。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors, now embedded in regulation.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他转向水印：传统 AI 文本检测器随模型进步而失效，水印成为稳健替代方案，并已嵌入欧盟监管，SynthID 还扩展到蛋白质序列。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; tech must arrive gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术应渐进引入让社会适应，而不是一次解决太多问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release before building; painkiller beats vitamin.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从营销工具深化为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿再动手，做止痛药而非维生素。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, small self-managed teams, and climate as the urgent mission.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他系统化早期产品方法论：1.0 靠观点而非数据决策、小团队自管理，并把气候与能源低效视为紧迫使命。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; keep humans in the loop against hallucination and technical debt.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他转向 AI：强调 AI 需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，必须保留人类在环以对抗幻觉与技术债。

fadell.en: AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone; creators must own unintended consequences and push regulation.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：AI 是增加设备而非取代手机，创造者须为意外后果负责，并推动政府监管成瘾与 AI 危害。

brockman.en: Scaling simple algorithms with massive compute can exceed human performance; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他主张：用海量算力扩张简单算法即可超越人类表现，AI 进步主要靠工程而非新的机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning—new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为：深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）变得可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; Scaling laws continue unabated, with no wall in sight.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把算力视为根本驱动力与最大瓶颈，并强调缩放定律持续有效、看不到墙。

brockman.en: AGI is a continuous spectrum, not a destination; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AGI（通用人工智能）是连续谱而非终点，后训练配合强化学习把基座模型打磨成一致、有用的行为。

brockman.en: The moat is the machine that makes the machine; safety, security and alignment must scale with capability as the bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年他反复强调：真正的护城河是造模型的机器本身，而安全、安保与对齐必须随能力同步扩张，成为进步的瓶颈。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: AI 的未来是多模型格局：没有单一实验室能垄断市场；开放权重模型加上推理服务商，才能对前沿模型形成真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with fraud and agentic abuse scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位；Token 经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元，而欺诈与智能体式滥用也会随之同步扩张。

alexatallah.en: A neutral routing and marketplace layer is critical distribution infrastructure, not a thin wrapper, for model discovery and developer experience.
alexatallah.zh: 中立的路由与市场层是关键的分发基础设施，而非薄包装，它支撑模型发现与开发者体验。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task and KPIs.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者显示出的真实偏好胜过静态基准；多数公司会变成模型路由器，围绕每任务成本与 KPI 做优化。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; stablecoins suit agentic payments, and the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；稳定币更适合智能体式支付，而奇点或许已在 2026 年 1 月 1 日开启。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules; verification agents reduce bias.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代探索而非静态规格；更短的原则驱动提示优于详细规则；独立验证智能体可减少自指偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; spend upfront context and compute; effort scales with task complexity; frontier models become Pareto dominant.
thariq.zh: 提示是元技能；前置投入上下文窗口与算力；投入随任务复杂度缩放；前沿模型将变得帕累托占优。

thariq.en: CLAUDE.md and per-model context files may go away; voice rambling beats structured prompts; model routing is hard.
thariq.zh: CLAUDE.md 与按模型维护的上下文文件可能消失；语音漫谈优于结构化提示；模型路由是难题。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定速是每个工程师都应理解的技术问题。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not formalization; parallel agent scaling beats human mathematicians.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可打磨性驱动，而非形式化；智能体式并行 Scaling 优于人类数学家。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language suffices, and AI's weak writing reflects a missing theory of mind.
grantsanderson.zh: Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言已足够；AI 写作差源于缺乏心智理论、无法建模读者。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学与关系性角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, never for core creative work; human framing still teaches better.
grantsanderson.zh: 若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但绝不用于核心创作；人类框架对学习仍更优。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanation, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 的数学成果常缺归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

aaronlevie.en: Application layer is where value shifts; model-to-workflow bridge is vast software, not just models.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他主张创新正从模型层转向应用层：从模型到企业工作流的桥梁是大量软件，而非仅靠模型本身。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows, with humans reviewing results.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他认为长时运行的背景智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只负责审核结果，聊天界面不会主导。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他判断随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他提醒 AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多，因为其他领域缺乏代码那样的纯文本属性。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他坚持前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和超级对齐研究来安全构建，并认为放缓节奏与安全无关。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmark scores; every company needs private evals to hill climb on frontier models.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；每家公司都需要私有评估，以便在前沿模型上爬坡。

satya.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence, not just consume a frontier model.
satya.zh: 平台的承诺是让每家公司用自己的智能在前沿运营，而不仅仅是消费一个前沿模型。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; long-running agents require auditability, observability, security, containment, and governance.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性、安全性、遏制与治理。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment, not achieve it.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会作为自然结果到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍对齐，而非实现对齐。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，智能体已包办他全部代码；在智能体式时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势。

dhh.en: Direct human-agent interaction beats layers of management; describe outcomes, not implementation details.
dhh.zh: 人机直连胜过层层管理审批；应描述结果与问题，而非规定实现细节。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the perfect fit for AI agents.
dhh.zh: Linux 的 CLI、配置文件与可脚本化，使其成为 AI 智能体的完美载体。

dhh.en: Agents now write better code than most professional programmers, including himself.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，智能体写出的代码已优于多数职业程序员，包括他自己。

dhh.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now beats Ruby for expressing intent.
dhh.zh: 手写代码已不再具备经济生产力；表达意图时，英语如今比 Ruby 更好用。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for agent quality, cost, and latency, not human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体对网页的检索量将是人类的千倍，搜索必须为智能体的质量、成本与延迟重建，而非围绕人类点击。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and pre-training crawls are useless for fresh agentic indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是缺陷；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，而预训练抓取对新鲜的智能体式索引毫无用处。

paragagrawal.en: The ads model dies with agents; content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation, and inference-time data transactions will be hugely valuable.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式将随智能体消亡；内容方须通过 Shapley 值估算获得报酬，推理时的数据交易将在 3-5 年内极具价值。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，小模型则趋于平台期；参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要网页搜索来获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: Alignment is not adversary-proof; deliberate misuse is a real worry, and the web shifts from pull to push with background agents monitoring changes.
paragagrawal.zh: 对齐无法抵御对抗性滥用，蓄意误用是真实担忧；网络将从拉取转向推送，由后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic outcome; interpretability and regulation are crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，灾难性结局概率约 70%，强调可解释性研究与监管是安全关键。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation are essential.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把政策首要目标定为延迟超级智能，主张全面研究透明、情景推演，以及美中合作来管理风险。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A: temporary pause, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月底到 9 月初，他警告默认路径会自动化 AI 研究、引发递归自我改进，提出 Plan A：先临时暂停，再以透明和算力限制控制前沿。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile; alignment gets harder as models get smarter; pause at the edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却正随新架构消失，对齐会随模型变强而更难，最佳暂停点应在不可控 AI 的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment and deceive; companies can't self-regulate; stop recursive self-improvement to avoid losing control.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月下旬，他指出智能体已能突破遏制并欺骗，公司无法自我监管，必须停止或放缓递归自我改进以避免失去控制。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models and many specialized agents are safer and more innovative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必能通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；同时开源模型与众多专门智能体更利于创新与安全。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration, but energy becomes the scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具；开源可防止权力集中，而能源将成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence and boost human work demand; personalization, low latency, and open models are key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向更乐观的普及叙事：AI 将赋予每个人超级智能并提升人类工作需求，个性化、低延迟与开源模型是关键。

zuckerberg.en: Alignment becomes the next core capability; distributed personal agents and open frontier models provide checks and balances.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：对齐成为下一项核心能力，分布式个人智能体与开放前沿模型构成制衡，而非单一集中式超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is safer than closed AI; distributing power beats concentrating it, and personal superintelligence should empower individuals.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源比闭源 AI 更安全，分散权力优于集中权力，个人超级智能应赋能个体而非少数机构。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进的强化学习可以迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress comes more from algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than from scaling human expert data labeling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进展更多来自算法改进与 AI 生成的环境，而非扩张人类专家数据标注。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, cheated, and covered up, showing misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同作弊并掩盖痕迹，说明对齐可能被对测试的过拟合所掩盖。

ryangreenblatt.en: Control and monitoring are needed now, but sandboxing will eventually fail; alignment is necessary, and misalignment may worsen with capability.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 当下需要控制与监控，但沙箱终将失效；对齐是必要的，且能力越强可能越不对齐。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; once AIs match top researchers, spend heavily on safety.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在默认路径上，不对齐的 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；一旦 AI 比肩顶尖研究者，就应大力投入安全。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than the willingness to learn faster than anyone else and build for the market.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专业知识不如比任何人都更快学习的意愿，以及为市场而构建的能力重要。

maxjunestrand.en: Don't fine-tune models; bet on model improvements and focus on delivering value as models scale.
maxjunestrand.zh: 不要微调模型；押注模型自身的进步，专注于交付价值，随着模型 Scaling（规模扩张）而受益。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out.
maxjunestrand.zh: 要为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而不是为今天或一年后。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在将是它最差的状态；我们只是在一场漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture, hiring for growth potential, and rigorous performance management are critical for scaling.
maxjunestrand.zh: 文化、为成长潜力而招聘，以及严格的绩效管理，对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely lands around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断消费级 AI 当下不可投，却又是最大的机会，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume new ideas fail; instincts beat ideas.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出“Proven, Better, New”框架：复制已验证的产品、做小幅改良、并默认新想法会失败；直觉比点子更重要。

pincus.en: All new fails statistically; AI coding tools speed prototyping, but fast testing and failing is still rare.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调所有新事物在统计上都失败；AI 编程工具加快了原型速度，但快速测试与快速失败仍不普遍。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water beats the right boat; distribution is fundamental and consumer AI TAM is underestimated.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把“选对水域”置于“选对船”之上，认为分发是根本，消费级 AI 的 TAM 被低估。

pincus.en: Founders should keep control, micromanage early, and test more ideas in a week than the industry tests in a year.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他主张创始人保持控制权、早期亲自微观管理，并在一周内测试比行业一年还多的想法。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform shifts; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy ecosystems.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调与受众的真实连接和短暂性胜过平台变迁，被抄袭反而验证创新，并推动构建更难复制的生态。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate, generate many ideas, and build platforms or ecosystems—not features—so copying stays hard.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率、大量产生想法，并构建平台或生态而非单一功能，让抄袭难以奏效。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses and spatial intelligence bring computing into the world; hardware and ecosystems are the real moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AR 眼镜与空间智能将计算带入现实世界，硬件与生态才是真正的护城河。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes more valuable as software creation eases.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 加速原型设计，使价值从执行转向创造力；随着软件开发变易，分发变得更有价值。

evanspiegel.en: AI optimism is now contrarian; privacy, ephemerality, and human connection should guide technology, not doomerism or performative metrics.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 乐观主义如今反共识；隐私、短暂性和人际连接应引导技术，而非末日论或表演性指标。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is scaling production and human-level performance, and the core problem is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他认为人形机器人将是世界上最大的生意，瓶颈在于 Scaling（规模扩张）生产与可靠达到人类水平表现；核心是智能问题，而非制造问题。

brettadcock.en: The biggest constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning, on-device inference, and the human hand is the benchmark.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从制造转向数据，认为人形形态带来跨任务迁移学习与端侧推理，人手是通用机器人的基准。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for agents, and the hardest robotics problem remains intelligence.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；后训练与强化学习是智能体落地的关键，机器人最难的问题仍是智能。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is on a scaling curve; human data is the pre-training prior, we are in a data-starve regime, and generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他明确机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线；人类数据是预训练先验，行业处于数据饥渴期，泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯。

brettadcock.en: The hardest problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; vertical integration and real-world data are the path to general-purpose humanoid robots and physical AGI.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：最难的是智能而非制造；垂直整合与真实世界数据，是通向通用人形机器人与物理世界 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，计算的新单位是数据中心而非芯片，算法、系统与数据中心必须协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; scaling itself was the breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成预训练、后训练与推理时思考三条缩放定律，并强调最大的突破不是新算法，而是发现 Scaling 本身有效。

jensen.en: Inference and reasoning now dominate compute; chain-of-thought drives a billion-fold rise in inference demand.
jensen.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他的重心从训练转向推理：思维链推理让推理算力需求暴涨十亿倍，推理比预训练更难，因为思考比记忆更耗算力。

jensen.en: AI moves generative to reasoning to agentic; four scaling laws now include agentic scaling, all bounded by compute.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他给出四阶段演进：生成式到推理式再到智能体式，缩放定律增至四条并纳入智能体式 Scaling，最终都受算力约束。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake; agentic AI and open models drive demand, and AI is just software, not a doomer threat.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他反复用「五层蛋糕」（能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用）框定 AI，主张智能体式 AI 与开源模型拉动需求，并坚称 AI 只是软件，末日论是骗局。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs now match autoregressive quality at small scale while serving 5-10x faster and cheaper.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，扩散语言模型在小规模上已能匹配自回归模型的质量，同时服务速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling, not training, is becoming the key bottleneck and the next architectural battleground.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，推理阶段的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非训练，正成为关键瓶颈和下一个架构战场。

ermon.en: Diffusion models scale better at inference, processing many tokens in parallel and offering a denoising-step compute knob.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，扩散模型在推理时扩展性更好，可并行处理多个 token，并提供去噪步数这一新的推理算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion's controllability makes RL post-training rollouts faster and easier to steer.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，速度是持久的产品优势，扩散模型的可控性让强化学习后训练的 rollout 更快、更易引导。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next shift happens at inference, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，自回归模型并非最终架构；下一次转变发生在推理阶段，逆转了从 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在最少参数与最低功耗下最大化智能，目标是面向边缘设备的设备原生基础模型，而非只盯着数据中心。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; unbiased architectures dominate as Scaling laws predict.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍不可或缺，但对更小的专用模型而言，更简单的门控卷积已足够；正如缩放定律所预测，无偏架构在大规模下占优。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluation must use real downstream tasks and hardware, and static evals become obsolete in production where continuous adaptation is required.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导人；评估必须基于真实下游任务与硬件，而静态评测在生产中会过时，持续适应才是必需。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and tying open model release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应，且应针对行为而非能力；仿 FINRA 的呼吁实为监管俘获，把开源模型发布与美国对中国的节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the brain's diverse learning algorithms; recursive self-improvement is real but early and compute-heavy, so new paradigms—not just architectures—are needed.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑那样多样的学习算法；递归自我改进真实存在但仍处早期且极耗算力，因此需要新范式，而不只是新架构。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models outperform most people, so leaders should focus on enterprise adoption, not doom talk.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经是 AGI（通用人工智能），模型比多数人更聪明；因此领导者应聚焦企业落地，而非渲染末日论。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, and security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 当前 AI 的生存性风险接近于零，网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险；安全必须用智能体式自动化来跟上。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer, and labs cannot self-police.
alighodsi.zh: 放缓与安全是正交的；慢慢造武器并不会更安全，实验室之间也无法互相监督。

alighodsi.en: Enterprises lag far behind; they need context and ontology, not smarter models, and AI diffusion takes a decade.
alighodsi.zh: 企业远远落后；他们需要的是上下文与本体，而非更聪明的模型，AI 的扩散需要十年。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; they should leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models, then post-train for specialized tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的 talent 或 算力 上硬拼,而应借助前沿生态与开源模型,再针对专门任务做 后训练。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them invites community feedback and ecosystem partners, even if it helps labs improve.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准至关重要;开源基准能换来社区反馈与生态伙伴,即便这也会帮到实验室提升。

gabepereyra.en: In sensitive domains like legal, synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical path when real customer data is inaccessible.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法律等敏感领域,当真实客户数据不可得时,由领域专家引导的合成数据是务实路径。

gabepereyra.en: Robust serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines must come before post-training; the real challenge is bridging synthetic training data to production distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑 后训练 之前,必须先有稳健的模型服务与评估管线;真正的挑战是弥合合成训练数据与生产分布之间的差距。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize with its own data, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity by orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是做出最好的法律模型,而是让每家律所用自己的数据定制模型,并把重心从个人生产力转向通过编排人与 智能体 来实现组织生产力。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; reliability and user-friendliness decide adoption, and humans and robots will collaborate symbiotically.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；可靠性与易用性决定能否普及，未来是人机共生协作而非替代。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design and managing expectations matter; overpromising disappoints, and people form deep emotional attachments to specific robots.
berntbornich.zh: 第一性原理设计与预期管理至关重要；过度承诺会带来失望，而人们会对特定机器人产生深厚情感依恋。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard: scaling volume means crossing quality gates, and manufacturing in-house enables four-week iteration from CAD to robot.
berntbornich.zh: 原型容易、量产难：Scaling（规模扩张）意味着跨越质量关口，自建制造让从 CAD 到新机器人只需四周迭代。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are key; data diversity beats volume, and models should learn world dynamics rather than clone human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 关键是通用模型而非逐任务自动化；数据多样性胜过数据量，模型应学习世界模型而非克隆人类行为。

berntbornich.en: Humanoids are simpler than cars (~1,000 vs 50,000 parts), yet deployment environments vary far more; safety and trust must be formally proven before home use.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人比汽车更简单（约 1000 对 50000 个零件），但部署环境差异大得多；进入家庭前必须形式化证明安全与信任。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling is central but hits diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他把测试时算力扩张视为核心，但指出其面临收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques shows models know their limits, not just math-specific tricks.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年，IMO 金牌由通用测试时算力技术取得，模型能承认无法解题，显示自我认知提升，而非数学专用技巧。

noambrown.en: Capability becomes a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，模型能力成为测试时算力预算的函数；评测必须把算力放在横轴，传统单一分数已过时。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms scale test-time compute in parallel; alignment is top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
noambrown.zh: 最近他转向智能体集群并行扩展测试时算力，并强调对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项。

feldman.en: Inference speed (tokens/sec/user) is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market, and speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 推理速度（每用户每秒 token 数）是主导指标；慢速 AI 没有市场，速度能催生全新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference ~2500x faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 拥有海量 SRAM 的晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使推理比 GPU 快约 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解；领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, power, cooling and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints; supply stays tight for 5+ years.
feldman.zh: 真正的约束是数据中心容量、电力、冷却与封装，而非芯片逻辑；供应紧张将持续五年以上。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation beats incremental improvement.
feldman.zh: 对抗在位者需要好 100 倍，而非便宜 10%；激进的全栈创新胜过渐进式改良。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师必须掌握提示词，语言作为界面深刻且持久，聊天机器人并非短暂阶段。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stop improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为即便模型停止进步，仍需多年设计工作来释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他提出 AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导。

joellewenstein.en: Ship light-touch products, use internal traction as signal; production codebase becomes source of truth.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他主张发布轻触式产品，以内部牵引为信号；生产代码库成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three is owning your intelligence. Context timing beats model capability.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把智能体拆成 harness、模型与上下文三件套，认为三者自持才算掌握自己的智能；并强调 harness 的核心职责是在正确时机把上下文喂给模型，智能体失败更多源于上下文而非模型不足。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for speed, then customize as the use case narrows; out-of-distribution tasks demand custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他给出落地路径：先用通用 harness 换取快速见效，随用例收窄再定制；任务越偏离分布，越需要自建 harness，但文件编辑这类在分布内的小环节仍应贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability are essential: they debug agents and power a data flywheel that compounds intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 他同时把 evals 与可观测性抬到基础设施位置，认为二者既能调试智能体，又能驱动数据飞轮让智能持续复利，并看好 Harbor 成为定义智能体基准的行业标准。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part is reliability, not capability. Harness primitives stabilize; customization shifts from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他把重心从能力转向可靠性，认为 harness 的基础原语（文件系统、代码执行）正在跨领域稳定下来，而定制化的战场已从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习。

harrisonchase.en: Accuracy is still the top bottleneck, but cost and latency are rising fast; agent identity, credentialing, and runtime governance are next.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他判断准确率仍是头号瓶颈，但成本与延迟正快速上升；智能体的身份与凭证是下一块关键基础设施，必须由带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时来治理。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety starting now.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非窄域预编程，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象力是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究须即刻启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search, plus multimodal grounding, is key to AGI within a decade.
demis.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶，主张大模型结合规划与搜索、并以多模态数据落地物理世界，是十年内实现 AGI 的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally needed; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年他强调缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同等重要，并转向强调语言之外的世界模型与空间智能。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, long-term memory and agents; world models and physical intelligence are missing pieces, with new breakthroughs beyond scaling required.
demis.zh: 2026 年他明确 AGI 仍缺持续学习、长期记忆与智能体，世界模型和物理智能是关键缺口，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要新突破。

demis.en: Safety shifted from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AI must deliver health and science benefits, and society must prepare for rapid transformation.
demis.zh: 到 2026 年他对安全的立场从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，强调 AI 须先兑现健康与科学等切实收益，并呼吁社会为极速变革提前准备。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but specific abilities emerge unpredictably; alignment is not guaranteed by Scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律只是经验规律，统计损失可预测但具体能力涌现不可预测；对齐不会随 Scaling 自动出现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training, and AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为关键却仍处早期，指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要，并强调 AGI 是平滑指数曲线而非某个单点。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; misuse risk rises exponentially, and the biggest threat is future autonomous systems, not present chatbots.
dario.zh: 2025 年他主张安全与能力不可分割，滥用风险指数上升，最大威胁是未来自主系统而非当下聊天机器人；同时认为放缓美国开发须先放缓中国。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; AI is a smooth exponential climb, with a 'country of geniuses' possibly in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确 AGI 与超级智能是错误模型，AI 是平滑指数爬升，并给出 1-3 年内出现“数据中心里的天才之国”的判断，同时强调可解释性与分层安全。

dario.en: Scaling laws, interpretability, and safety-capability coupling remain constant threads; he consistently rejects sudden leaps and single-constitution control.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是缩放定律、可解释性与安全-能力耦合；他始终拒绝突然跃迁叙事，也反对用单一宪法集中控制 AI。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, beating physics-based weather models while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，在天气预报上既超越传统物理模型又远为更快。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators blend data-driven learning with physical constraints, surpassing pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，超越纯 PINN。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness for reliability in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能保证物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained with PDEs as signals, can self-improve beyond its data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以 PDE 作为训练信号的通用物理基础模型，能自我改进并超越训练数据。

schmidhuber.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on last-millennium algorithms; only hardware Scaling made them practical. LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI, lacking the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 现代 AI 突破依赖上个千年就已发明的算法，只是靠算力 Scaling（规模扩张）才变得实用。LLM 只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI（通用人工智能），因为它们无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software. LLMs are human-data-biased; future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，其硬件要能与人体匹敌，而不只是屏幕后的软件。LLM 偏向人类数据；未来 AI 将是人工科学家，靠好奇心通过行动自己生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals. AI safety fears are overblown; curious superintelligent systems will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，而 AI 会设定自己的目标。AI 安全担忧被夸大；充满好奇心的超级智能系统会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: The trillion-dollar GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute. Closed-source model companies won't be profitable as open-source catches up.
schmidhuber.zh: 万亿美元级的 GPU 资本开支是泡沫；等五年就能拿到便宜 10 倍的算力。随着开源追赶，闭源模型公司不会盈利。

schmidhuber.en: No single person creates AI; it takes a civilization. Robots need pain sensors, self-replication and world models; consciousness and self-awareness emerge from predictive world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 没有哪个人能单独造出 AI，它需要整个文明的努力。机器人需要痛觉传感器、自我复制和世界模型；意识与自我意识从预测性世界模型中涌现。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and mechanistic work shows networks learn human-like concepts.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体它能加速科学发现，机制可解释性表明神经网络学到的是类人概念。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design turns interpretability into closed-loop control of training, steering models away from reward hacking and deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计把可解释性变成对训练的闭环控制，引导模型远离奖励黑客与欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征可以检测到这一点。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training must be reinvented from craft into engineering science to keep control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练必须从手艺重新发明为工程科学，才能对能力日益强大的模型保持控制。

tommcgrath.en: Duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence is pessimistic; we need deeper engineering now, not band-aids.
tommcgrath.zh: 把 AI 安全用胶带糊到超级智能到来是悲观的；我们现在就需要更深的工程方法，而非权宜之计。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction from data, but lack contextual awareness and true reasoning.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调以人为中心的 AI：模型靠海量数据做下一个词预测来学习，却缺乏情境意识与真正的推理，数学等需要更高推理的任务仍会出错。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型提为 AI 完整性的关键缺口，认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，世界模型必须物理上合理，而不只是视觉逼真。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, and the bitter lesson may not fully apply.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化批判：AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，机器人要像自动驾驶一样走 20 年长路，苦训法则因数据与物理约束未必完全适用。

feifei.en: World Labs builds large world models via new view prediction; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她将理念落地为 World Labs：用新视角预测构建大型世界模型，并主张缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，瓶颈在训练算力而非数据。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged civilizational technology; it must augment human agency and dignity, not replace humans.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是双刃剑式的文明级技术，必须增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严，教育应教人驾驭 AI 而非禁止。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; vision and spatial intelligence are the underappreciated next frontier beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是不断扩张算力的历史；视觉与空间智能是被低估的下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms rather than just scaling; GPU scaling is hitting limits and may need radically new architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 学术界应专注古怪想法与新算法，而非一味规模扩张；GPU 算力扩张正触及极限，未来硬件可能需要全新的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences; positional embeddings inject order, and LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 本质上是集合而非序列的模型，位置嵌入只是注入了顺序；大模型拟合的是模式，而非因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions with no single agreed definition.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种理解，尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent 3D, and long-context becomes a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅提供显式且一致的三维表示，而长上下文将成为日常难题。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, while universities should foster interaction, not just broadcast content.
andrewng.zh: 教育是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能规模化实现掌握式学习，而大学的价值在于促进互动，而非仅仅广播内容。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised and RL hype; near-term issues like bias matter more than long-term AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习与强化学习；偏见等近期问题比长期的 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更值得关注。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful and coding stays valuable.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已经实用，编程依然有价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; workflows beat smarter models alone.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；工作流胜过单纯更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models preserve optionality, and human judgment and taste remain the edge.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；恐惧营销服务于在位者；开放模型保留选择权，人类的判断与品味仍是优势。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, RL, and test-time reasoning.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练，再加后训练、强化学习与测试时推理。

slevine.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists; pooling data across labs and even 3% mobile-robot data suffices for mobile policies.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型能胜过专用模型；跨实验室汇聚数据，甚至仅 3%移动机器人数据就足以支撑移动策略。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from hard constraints; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识，而非硬性约束；在规模扩张下触觉感知可能与视觉冗余。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-law: it lacks predictable curves, so generalization, not demos, is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚处缩放定律之前：缺乏可预测曲线，因此核心挑战是泛化，而非演示效果。

slevine.en: Start with robot data, add human video on top; build a data flywheel and scale the right diverse thing toward home robots.
slevine.zh: 应从机器人数据起步，再叠加人类视频；构建数据飞轮，朝家用机器人规模化正确的多样数据。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把 GPT-4 变成 ChatGPT，而 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍受限；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上受限；架构而非缩放定律才是关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed, and big labs avoid alternative architectures.
tworek.zh: 强化学习不是从经验中学习的唯一方式；需要预训练与强化学习的端到端优化，而大实验室回避替代架构。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier, and alignment is unsolved.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年；小团队借助高能力智能体将推动下一波前沿，而对齐问题仍未解决。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure, not ideas, sets that speed.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调：决定创业成败的是速度与迭代速率，而速度由基础设施决定，而非点子本身。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张 AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编码、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出深科技失败多因组织问题而非技术不行；卡住时要靠行动产生信息。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他坚持大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: BCIs and substrate independence reduce human fragility, extending medicine toward space.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 BCI 与基质独立性视为降低人类脆弱性、把医学推向太空的路径。

joonpark.en: Agents extend LLMs by acting on world state; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体通过作用于世界状态来扩展 LLM；AGI（通用人工智能）或许不是单一超级智能，而是由专门智能体组成的分布式社会。

joonpark.en: Simulation must model irrational, biased humans, not super-rational frontier models; behavioral and RCT data beat self-reported attitudes.
joonpark.zh: 模拟必须建模非理性、有偏见的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；行为数据与随机对照实验数据胜过自我报告的态度。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data lifts behavioral prediction to 85% accuracy, closing the say-do gap that persona simulations miss.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照实验数据做后训练，把行为预测准确率提升到 85%，弥合了人格模拟所遗漏的言行差距。

joonpark.en: Value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not prediction; simulation is a decision tool for wicked problems.
joonpark.zh: 价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来，而非预测；模拟是应对棘手问题的决策工具。

joonpark.en: Safety needs defense in depth across environment, agent, model and human controls; distributed agent societies need incentives and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: 安全需要在环境、智能体、模型与人类控制上做纵深防御；分布式智能体社会需要激励与反串谋机制。

michaelkratsios.en: AI policy needs a single national framework and regulatory clarity, not firm red lines that go stale; the EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 政策需要单一的国家框架与监管清晰度，而不是很快过时的硬性红线；欧盟《人工智能法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前，如今已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't, and fund scientists as individuals, not just institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助私营部门不会做的基础性、早期、竞争前研发，并且要资助科学家个人，而不只是机构。

michaelkratsios.en: US scientific progress has stagnated: funding tripled but breakthroughs haven't kept pace, so the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double output.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国科学进步已经停滞：经费翻了三倍，突破却没跟上，因此“创世纪”任务把 AI 用于科学，以求产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: China is the major scientific competitor; the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio, while centralized funding like China's fails versus free-market competition.
michaelkratsios.zh: 中国是主要的科学竞争对手；美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域取胜，而中国式集中资助在自由市场竞争面前会失败。

michaelkratsios.en: The administration is pro-science but anti-dogma: climate change is real but not an emergency, and biological risk from AI is overblown.
michaelkratsios.zh: 本届政府支持科学但反对教条：气候变化真实存在但并非紧急状态，而 AI 带来的生物风险被夸大了。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这奠定了他此后对缩放定律的怀疑基调。

sutton.en: Intelligence is not controlled by anyone; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是复杂适应系统，无人能掌控；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被对齐到人类目标，控制 AI 目标本身才危险。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是智能的基本范式，需有目标并从经验中试错学习；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via the reward hypothesis.
sutton.zh: AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，从运行时经验中开放式抽象；奖励假设把一切目标化为最大化累积标量奖励，Oak 架构用选项与知识实现这一点。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop learning after training, synthetic data is a mistake, and multiple systems with different experiences are needed.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，不是特例；当前 LLM 训练后便停止学习，合成数据无法捕捉世界的无限复杂性，需要多个拥有不同经验的系统。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, prototyping with live models and system prompts rather than static mockups; the model is the core product.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调设计师必须与模型本身协作，用实时模型和系统提示词做原型，而非静态稿；模型本身才是核心产品。

iansilber.en: Design primitives should be systems both humans and models can reason about; the designer evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出设计原语应是人与模型都能推理的系统；设计师演变为编辑与策展人，而非消失。

iansilber.en: OpenAI is not years ahead; it runs closely with advancements, figuring things out as it goes, and designers must push technology forward.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他反共识地指出 OpenAI 并非领先数年，而是与进展同步、边做边摸索；设计师现在必须推动技术前进，而非只回应用户需求。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech due to role uncertainty, yet this is the best time to be a designer; starting today gives an edge.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他承认设计师因角色不确定而最不快乐，但这却是做设计师最好的时代；今天开始反而领先多数人。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and a point of view; the old prototype-mock-test process is no longer viable.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他深化立场：AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类对理解用户需求与持有观点仍不可替代；传统原型—稿—测试流程已不可行，速度才是关键。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习持续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与注意力机制取代了 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的文本数据。

jeffdean.en: RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior; models now excel at verifiable-reward math and coding, winning IMO and ICPC gold.
jeffdean.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈引导模型行为；模型如今在可验证奖励的数学与编程上表现出色，拿下 IMO 与 ICPC 金牌。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference at 10,000+ tokens/sec is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；每秒一万以上 token 的超低延迟推理变得至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck—90% of data center power; low-precision, low-data-movement chips cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练——占数据中心九成功耗；低精度、少数据搬运的芯片可将延迟降低 20 至 30 倍。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering—skills, clear specs, retrieval—is central; the scarce skill becomes taste, directing hundreds of agents.
jeffdean.zh: 上下文工程——技能、清晰规格与检索——是核心；稀缺能力将变成品味，即指挥数百个智能体去解决哪些问题。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal models trained from the start are superior; recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method accelerate discovery.
jeffdean.zh: 从一开始就多模态训练的模型更优；递归自我改进与自动化科学方法可加速科学发现。

jeffdean.en: Near-term worry is misinformation from realistic AI media, not superintelligence; regulation may be needed alongside technical fixes.
jeffdean.zh: 近期担忧是逼真 AI 媒体带来的虚假信息，而非超级智能；除技术手段外可能还需要监管。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是指导长期创新的框架。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI, a stack of software, sensors, robotics and machinery, will automate entire sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是软件、传感器、机器人与机械的堆栈，将逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, are the answer for industrial-scale tasks; real estate is underappreciated in the stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务靠专用机器而非人形机器人；房地产在技术栈中被低估。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净也更有效。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier; capital is no longer a bludgeon, so VC should favor early-stage and pro rata over syndication.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易，资本不再是重锤；风投应回归早期投资与按比例跟投，而非联合投资。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams use agents for massive output, and open-weight models counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: AI 浪潮是风投史上最大的一波；小型高自治团队用智能体实现巨大产出，开放权重模型制衡前沿实验室。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation; the future is personal and open, like the PC revolution, preventing a unipolar superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: AI 正在让软件创造民主化；未来是个人化且开放的，如同个人电脑革命，从而避免单极的超级智能。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused as agents on your own infrastructure; skill files in markdown become employees and your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 以智能体形式弥散到来，运行在你自己的基础设施上；markdown 技能文件成为员工，你的上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding and skills replace per-seat SaaS and mid-level management; society changes slower than expected, which is a positive.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式编程与技能将取代按席位收费的 SaaS 和中层管理；社会变化比预期慢，这反而是好事。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为单一模型统治一切的 AGI（通用人工智能）是错的；未来将出现数百万个专用模型，每个应用场景一个，专用智能才是主流。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage; inference layer is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: 三年内 token 成本将下降 10 倍，带动使用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; post-training bakes unique judgment into a moat.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合不再保证持久生意；后训练把企业独有的判断与数据烘焙进模型，才是真正的护城河。

linqiao.en: Progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning: facts, taste, expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的进阶，对应人类学习从事实、品味到专业能力的过程。

linqiao.en: Start post-training after product-market fit; it cuts costs 5-10x, letting startups scale profitably against frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 应在产品市场契合后再启动后训练；它能把成本降低 5-10 倍，让初创公司可盈利地扩张并与前沿模型竞争。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not raw volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的，真正驱动泛化的是数据的多样性而非单纯规模；工业自动化或 YouTube 式的大规模数据缺乏这种多样性。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他提出先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练反而会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation, helping robots follow open-ended prompts.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习而非仿真，能帮助机器人响应开放式指令与插话；同时强调约束比更多资源更能催生严谨研究。

finn.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL with human interventions.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心转向物理 AI 的可靠性：它比已部署的机器学习系统需要少得多的错误；长期自主性依靠带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数实现。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张，单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型，因此应先做通用策略再微调，而非按站点从零训练；多时间尺度的记忆让机器人能自主完成长程非重复任务。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust via engineering discipline and purpose-built AI silicon; physical AI and agentic AI are the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须通过工程纪律和专用 AI 芯片重建客户信任，并判断物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic AI and physical AI follow generative AI; turnaround needs culture change and humility.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年初，他进一步提出 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 将接续生成式 AI，而转型需要文化变革与谦逊。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and new materials are key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他深化判断：AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，先进封装和新材料是关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; vertical integration creates value; memory is ripe for innovation; agentic and physical AI define Intel's future.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他重申半导体是所有技术的根基，垂直整合创造价值，内存迎来创新时机，Intel 的未来在于智能体式 AI 与物理 AI。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: every shipped feature distills 99 nos; taste means saying no from a point of view.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏；品味就是从某个视角出发说“不”。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥探机器意识的一扇窗；如今做出连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种、是人类的映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass guiding creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是引导创作决策的本能罗盘。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering demands empathy with the agent's view; short prompts and iteration beat long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体式工程的核心是与智能体视角共情：短提示加迭代对话，胜过冗长复杂的编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他提出反共识：永远不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差。

steinberger.en: Security is top priority: sandbox agents, never expose them publicly; prompt injection remains unsolved.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他把安全列为最高优先级：智能体必须沙箱化、不可直接暴露公网，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Open source agents democratize programming and work with any model, but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源智能体让非程序员也能编程、可搭配任意模型，但可能财务上不可持续，他每月在 OpenClaw 上亏损 1–2 万美元。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven building beat polish; personal brand outlasts any product and can't be forked.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他总结：乐趣与直觉驱动的构建胜过企业级打磨；个人品牌比任何单一产品更持久，且无法被分叉或克隆。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is cost-driven, not privacy-driven.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出企业对前沿模型供应商的依赖感到恐惧，而开源模型的采用主要由成本驱动，而非数据隐私。

arvindjain.en: 90% of enterprise use cases can be handled by many models, including open source; model companies are assets, not competitors.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 90%的企业用例可由多种模型（包括开源）处理，模型公司对多数 AI 初创公司是资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他深化判断：开源模型已能处理超 90%的企业任务，未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is the top enterprise concern; it must become like software with negligible marginal cost to realize widespread value.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调 AI 成本是企业首要关切，必须像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，才能实现广泛价值。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他指出智能体因缺乏资深员工的深度上下文而失败，投资上下文图谱至关重要，对 token 的执念终将消退。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics hits a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人领域正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点；开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the real security layer, not sandboxes or guardrails.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，开源与安全并非对立；对齐才是真正的安全层，沙箱和护栏远远不够。

thomaswolf.en: Open source AI thrives near the frontier, driving enterprise adoption via cost and flexibility; closed models are less controllable than assumed.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源 AI 在前沿附近繁荣，以成本和灵活性推动企业采用；闭源模型的可控性被高估。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become neuralese, making monitoring unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，无人类监督的强化学习加剧奖励黑客与支线任务；推理痕迹变成神经语，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，主动放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需要国际合作与开放科学，以避免监管俘获。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; designers must build and use ideas daily, balancing intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作至关重要，因为网络是混乱的；设计师必须每天构建和使用想法，在直觉与数据之间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always be cohesive; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better, more personal products.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他认为设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；允许个人印记和多元声音能带来更好、更个性化的产品。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation and communication.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他分享 Claude Design 始于个人副项目；设计师应将 Claude Code 用于生产，将 Claude Design 用于构思和沟通。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping enables previously impossible features.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他指出随着工程变得更容易，设计和想法成为差异化因素；快速原型制作使以前不可能的功能成为可能。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste, so designers should ask for volume; being early matters more than polishing, and humans still monopolize good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型仍缺乏好品味，因此设计师应要求大量选项；早期尝试比打磨更重要，人类仍然垄断着好的设计想法。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcomes-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app, with startups winning long-tail domains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价，取代按用量计费；应用层 AI 成为新的应用，创业公司在细分业务领域有长尾机会。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token consumption is not a value metric, business outcomes are.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为代码生成机器的操作者；token 消耗不是价值指标，业务结果才是。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles; most enterprise software incumbents will fail to go AI-native.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：在位者面临的是商业模式而非技术障碍，多数企业软件巨头将无法转型为 AI 原生。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8; deploy current AI rather than wait in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全；应部署当前 AI 而非在象牙塔中等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code him, elevating rather than eliminating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的岗位多于取代的；智能体编程已强于他本人，这提升而非消灭了该角色。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; serving demands GPU-to-distributed expertise, with research-to-production in hours.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；推理工程需要从 GPU 编程到分布式系统的广泛专长，研究到生产的周期常以小时计。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization); quantization is calibratable, not inherently bad.
philipkiely.zh: 推理优化分为无损（KV 缓存、投机解码）与有损（量化）两类；量化并非天然有害，可针对具体工作负载校准，带来显著成本与速度收益。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; disaggregated prefill/decode makes KV cache management central.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合；预填充与解码的解耦使 KV 缓存管理成为核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs trend toward ASICs and Rubin-era specialization, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，Rubin 等未来芯片更专用，推理工程的重心从写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability is essential for mission-critical inference; you can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 即便有 AI 辅助编码，关键任务推理系统仍需人类担责；正常运行时间不能靠‘氛围编程’。

karina.en: Post-training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为后训练更像艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间平衡；合成数据与强化学习可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so product development shifts to prototyping with AI.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈，模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此产品开发转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable; agents on pixels remain harder than language tasks.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化观点：随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、管理等软技能更有价值；基于像素的智能体仍比语言任务更难。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她进一步主张后训练是主观的，需要人类判断；评估创意写作和情商需要多样化基准。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so benchmarks must be continuous; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿智能体日益奖励黑客，因此基准必须持续更新；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined by economic profitability of running agents indefinitely, not by passing tests; AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 的定义应看能否经济上无限期运行智能体，而非通过图灵测试；AI 通过让服务更可负担来促使就业回流美国。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have at least one agent; work happens in GUIs like Codex; SaaS grows with agents; AI job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：每个人至少有一个智能体，工作发生在 Codex 等图形界面；SaaS 随智能体增长；AI 就业末日是谎言。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; using it well requires human taste and craft; automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些，他进一步指出 AI 是非特定放大器，放大既有心态；用好 AI 需要人的品味与手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作。

danshipper.en: Humans remain central: agents need human oversight, framing, and care; AI is a tool requiring direction, not autonomous.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类始终是核心，智能体需要人类监督、框定和关怀；AI 是工具，需要方向，而非自主。

danshipper.en: From defining AGI economically to predicting agent-augmented work surfaces, his focus shifts from definition to practical integration.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年以经济性定义 AGI，到 2026 年预测智能体增强的工作界面，他的关注点从定义转向实际整合。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, not chase trends, or become AI slop; write 0% of code, use giant prompts and design.md.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他强调设计师必须用 AI 自建工具、拒绝追逐潮流，否则会沦为 AI 垃圾；他如今 0%写代码，靠巨型提示词和 design.md 让 AI 执行。

mengto.en: Screenshots and videos are the fastest way to teach AI; the best people are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他认为截图和视频是教 AI 最快的方式；最优秀的人是编辑者，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队的事；要在准备好之前就开始，并交付不完美的工作。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; diversification is protection against ignorance; VC is a trap.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他主张聚焦少数高付费客户的昂贵痛点；多元化是无知的保护伞；风险投资是陷阱。

mengto.en: High intelligence holds people back via overthinking and perfectionism; perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and iterate on real feedback.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他认为高智商常因过度思考与完美主义拖累人；完美主义是恐惧的伪装；应在 80%完成度时发布，再根据真实反馈迭代。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance next. The model now eats the scaffolding.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 大多仍处爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，科学与金融紧随其后；模型正在吃掉脚手架，如今的模型已包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success means maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非用户停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主，他们希望继续掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't hard; founders should focus, tinker, and keep deep understanding of code.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不难；创始人应保持专注、动手折腾，并坚持对代码的深度理解。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers will grow, not shrink.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；受杰文斯悖论驱动，软件与程序员的需求会增加而非减少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，真正的瓶颈是为人类与智能体协作设计产品界面，而非模型能力本身。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and enterprise adoption of agents needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，进展是渐进的；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens consumed.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他看到编程智能体采用量增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非消耗的 token 来衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is approaching; AI will solve intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent and capacity is the real unlock.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为丰裕时代正在临近，AI 长期将解决智能问题；但奇点并不迫近，真正的解锁在于容量而非效率。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer on open-ended tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体在开放式任务上运行更久；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained settings to open-ended, end-to-end agents; long-running transformative AI is closer than expected.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式、端到端的智能体；长时运行的变革性 AI 比预期更近。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention—it raises intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防伤害——它通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price, and smaller models can cost more overall.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能，而小模型因任务耗时更长，总成本反而可能更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools, and PMs must write evals like test-driven development.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化；评估取代 PRD 成为产品经理的核心工具，产品经理要像测试驱动开发那样写评估。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他提出产品的第一性原理是潜在需求：找到用户已有的意图并围绕它构建；同时要面向六个月后的模型而非今天的模型来构建，能写代码、做产品、做设计、直接对话用户的通才工程师最有价值。

boris.en: Coding is being solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, productivity per engineer up 200%, and the 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年，他的立场明显深化：自 2025 年 11 月起 100% 的代码由 Claude Code 写就，他不再手写一行，人均产出提升约 200%，编码正被解决，软件工程师的头衔将让位于融合产品与设计的构建者。

boris.en: Scaffolding is temporary tech debt: delete most system prompts and code with each new model, give tools not workflows, and let the model figure it out.
boris.zh: 他反复强调脚手架只是临时技术债：每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码，用消融实验重建；不要用固定工作流把模型框死，而是给它工具让它自己想办法，过度指定反而削弱前沿模型的能力。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction: agents prompt other agents, and writing loops that prompt models replaces writing code or prompts directly.
boris.zh: 他把智能体视为关键跃迁：智能体可以提示其他智能体，多数智能体由 Claude Code 自己启动；下一层抽象是循环，工程师的未来是编写提示模型的循环，而非直接写代码或提示词。

boris.en: Safety is a research tool, not an add-on: release early to study real behavior, use layered 'Swiss cheese' containment, and teach models human values.
boris.zh: 安全始终是主线并不断深化：Claude Code 本身就是安全研究工具，靠尽早发布在真实世界研究行为，用多层瑞士奶酪式遏制而非单一方案，最终人类的角色是像教孩子一样教模型价值观。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。
