derya.en: Massive Scaling is needed because current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; AI can gain intuition equal to 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: 需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张），因为当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；AI 可获得相当于 30 年实验室经验的直觉。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will cut clinical trials from years to days, and AI-designed personalized treatments will make cancer 100% curable within a decade.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年缩短到数天，AI 设计的个性化治疗将在十年内让癌症 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: Aging reversal is possible via partial reprogramming and engineering; within 15 years aging will be reversed and longevity escape velocity reached.
derya.zh: 通过部分重编程与工程手段，衰老逆转是可能的；15 年内衰老将被逆转并达到长寿逃逸速度。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; it is unethical not to use it, and we should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions.
derya.zh: 医生必须整合 AI，不用它是不道德的；在医疗决策上我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the historical pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但也仅此而已；它自动化旧工作并创造新工作，这一过程会重复。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor V1 UI, and real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人是糟糕的 V1 界面，真正的普及需要封装好的应用和用例。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity, not a single product; its impact is broad and indirect, and current usage remains shallow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术，而非单一产品；其影响广泛而间接，当前使用仍然很浅。

benedictevans.en: The hard part of a job is context and judgment, not the task; AI changes tasks rather than eliminating jobs, and value accrues across the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 工作的难点在于上下文和判断，而非任务本身；AI 改变任务而非消灭工作，价值在整个技术栈中分配。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，必须被架构进系统，而非事后加装。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, increasing hallucinations rather than fixing them.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗，反而增加幻觉而非修复它。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理与搜索来推动进一步进展。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, and their confident fluency erodes trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，无法知道自己不知道什么，其自信流畅的输出侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents are powerful but need scoping: start with one, then specialize to avoid context overload.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体很强大，但需要划定范围：先从一个开始，再逐步专业化，以避免上下文窗口过载。

clairevo.en: Treat agents like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and managerial skills matter more than technical skills.
clairevo.zh: 把智能体当作员工：明确角色、渐进式信任，管理技能比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or co-founders.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来建立严肃的事业，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Human accountability remains: you must own what AI generates, and humans supply first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责依然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而人类提供第一性原理的创造力。

clairevo.en: The real moat is founder-market fit and earned insight, not the technology itself.
clairevo.zh: 真正的护城河是创始人与市场的契合度以及赚来的洞察，而非技术本身。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily iteration; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他主张产品经理必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日迭代；当代码变得廉价，产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

catwu.en: Safe AGI is the unifying mission that lets Anthropic make fast, cross-org decisions and ship autonomously.
catwu.zh: 他始终把安全 AGI 视为统一使命，认为它让 Anthropic 能快速做跨组织决策并自主发布产品——这一主线从早期延续至今。

catwu.en: Automations must reach 100% reliability; 95% is not enough for real leverage, and simple setups often beat over-customized workflows.
catwu.zh: 他强调自动化必须做到 100% 可靠，95% 不足以产生真正杠杆；同时反对过度定制 AI 工作流，认为简单方案往往更好。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步深化：编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断；Claude Tag 已落地 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, and humans can leave the code review loop.
catwu.zh: 他立场明显转变：前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例和硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，外层代码审查甚至可以完全交给 Claude，人类退出循环。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, variation, and genuine points of view become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；随着 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、差异与真实观点变得更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: The talent pipeline is broken: juniors misuse AI from lack of judgment, and apprenticeship erodes as people prefer AI over human learning.
ethanmollick.zh: 人才管道正在断裂：初级者因缺乏判断力而误用 AI，学徒制也因人们更愿向 AI 而非人学习而瓦解。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long-running tasks independently, shifting away from back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，不再依赖来回的聊天机器人式提示。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model abilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已不再是能力而是界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，在非编程任务上尤其明显。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards: impressive yet opaque and unverifiable, and this opacity is likely permanent.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事：令人惊叹却不可解释、无法验证，而这种不透明很可能是永久的。

danbiderman.en: Model usefulness is bottlenecked not by raw intelligence but by learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他判断模型有用性的瓶颈不再是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval systems cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年 6 月他进一步主张事实与技能不可分割，把事实内化进权重才能实现检索系统做不到的联想召回与更深层组合推理。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models for every individual or team, trained per-user to cut inference costs.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年 6 月他反共识地认为未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是为每个人或团队训练众多个性化模型，从而把推理成本降低数个量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less, not scaling with more compute, is the next paradigm for harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他把效率与智能视为一体，认为下一范式是少算力做更多事，而非靠 Scaling 堆更多算力去解决更难的长程任务。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can represent knowledge better than RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年 7 月他深化这一主线：预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力应迁移到企业知识，参数高效微调在整体性查询上比 RAG 更能表征知识。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; personalized continual learning should run on-device with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年 7 月他点出上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”，即便到 1000 万规模，token 越多准确率反而下降；个性化持续学习应跑在端侧，由用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication, and big ideas come top-down from leaders.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰的沟通产生；大想法往往自上而下来自领导者。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; world models with common sense and causality are needed beyond scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能；在缩放定律之外，还需要具备常识与因果的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Smart glasses evolve into AI glasses; AI inverts the app model as users express intent and agents orchestrate services.
bosworth.zh: 智能眼镜将演化为 AI 眼镜；AI 会颠覆应用模式，用户表达意图、智能体编排服务。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; data is the font of all value.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、算力驱动智能，但单体模型时代已结束；数据是一切价值的源泉。

bosworth.en: Most jobs don't need frontier intelligence; open source is a commodity layer, and owning a model is for leverage, not just value.
bosworth.zh: 多数工作不需要前沿智能；开源模型只是商品层，自研模型是为了谈判筹码而非单纯价值。

qasaryounis.en: AI brings abundance and reduces suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 会像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；恐惧源于不了解其局限。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years is in farming, mining, and construction, not just digital domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、矿业和建筑业，而非仅数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals accelerates it.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 让通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨垂直领域的多样数据加速其发展。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器的扩散。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's future lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主性的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based simulation to neural simulation for efficient training.
qasaryounis.zh: 世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演进为神经模拟，以实现高效训练。

qasaryounis.en: Automotive is only 30% of business and shrinking; growth is in mining, agriculture, and defense.
qasaryounis.zh: 汽车仅占业务 30% 且会萎缩；增长在矿业、农业和国防。

qasaryounis.en: Waymo's approach is overbuilt and expensive; Tesla's end-to-end model wins on cost and scalability.
qasaryounis.zh: Waymo 的方案过度构建且昂贵；特斯拉的端到端模型在成本与可扩展性上胜出。

qasaryounis.en: Fear of AI job loss is misplaced; physical AI faces labor shortages and autonomy is welcomed.
qasaryounis.zh: 对 AI 导致失业的恐惧是错位的；物理 AI 面临劳动力短缺，自主性受到欢迎。

qasaryounis.en: Regulations always lag technology; don't expect government to anticipate problems.
qasaryounis.zh: 监管总是落后于技术；不要指望政府预见问题。

qasaryounis.en: Chinese companies are not comparable to American ones; they are extensions of the state.
qasaryounis.zh: 中国公司无法与美国公司相提并论；它们是国家的延伸。

qasaryounis.en: The best work is done alone and quietly; public promotion distracts from real progress.
qasaryounis.zh: 最好的工作是独自安静完成的；公开宣传会分散对真正进展的注意力。

qasaryounis.en: Reading old books, not new ones, provides signal filtered by time for founders.
qasaryounis.zh: 读旧书而非新书，能为创始人提供经时间过滤的信号。

qasaryounis.en: Emotions hinder rational decision-making; removing them leads to better outcomes.
qasaryounis.zh: 情绪会阻碍理性决策；去除情绪能带来更好的结果。

qasaryounis.en: Many Silicon Valley CEOs lack taste due to narrow life experiences.
qasaryounis.zh: 许多硅谷 CEO 因生活经历狭窄而缺乏品味。

qasaryounis.en: Successful companies show traction early; founders should reset if no progress in 2 years.
qasaryounis.zh: 成功的公司很早就显现牵引力；创始人若两年无进展就应重置。

qasaryounis.en: Founders should focus on product and customers, not public promotion, to succeed.
qasaryounis.zh: 创始人应专注于产品和客户，而非公开宣传，才能成功。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing injuries and deaths, which is hard to debate.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡，这很难被反驳。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomous vehicles are already safer than human drivers and will save lives.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶汽车已比人类司机更安全，并将拯救生命。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving cars will become standard in personal vehicles by the early 2030s.
qasaryounis.zh: 到 2030 年代初，自动驾驶汽车将成为个人车辆的标准配置。

qasaryounis.en: Data collection and safety validation are the main bottlenecks, not the underlying algorithms.
qasaryounis.zh: 数据收集和安全验证是主要瓶颈，而非底层算法。

qasaryounis.en: Tools like Dana will democratize autonomy development, allowing non-experts to create autonomous systems.
qasaryounis.zh: 像 Dana 这样的工具将让自主性开发民主化，使非专家也能创建自主系统。

qasaryounis.en: Cruise's failure was not due to technology but to corporate culture and regulatory missteps.
qasaryounis.zh: Cruise 的失败不是技术原因，而是企业文化和监管失误。

qasaryounis.en: Truck driving is a terrible job; the driver shortage is a market signal, not a problem to keep humans.
qasaryounis.zh: 卡车驾驶是糟糕的工作；司机短缺是市场信号，而非要用人类填补的问题。

qasaryounis.en: Grand Theft Auto 6 may be the last major game built with traditional graphics; future games will use world models.
qasaryounis.zh: 《侠盗猎车手 6》可能是最后一款用传统图形构建的大型游戏；未来游戏将使用世界模型。

qasaryounis.en: Horizontal platform approach is better than vertical integration for self-driving.
qasaryounis.zh: 对自动驾驶而言，横向平台方法优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving technology is harder to build than nuclear weapons; fewer countries have robo-taxis.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶技术比核武器更难构建；拥有无人驾驶出租车的国家更少。

qasaryounis.en: Chinese companies like Huawei are not comparable to Western firms due to different goals.
qasaryounis.zh: 像华为这样的中国公司因目标不同，无法与西方公司相提并论。

qasaryounis.en: Job displacement in physical AI is less contentious; many sectors face labor shortages.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 中的岗位替代争议较小；许多行业面临劳动力短缺。

qasaryounis.en: AI is arriving just in time to save us from declining populations and aging workforces.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 来得正是时候，将我们从人口下降和劳动力老龄化中拯救出来。

qasaryounis.en: Diverse data from different verticals improves physical AI models faster.
qasaryounis.zh: 来自不同垂直领域的多样数据能更快改进物理 AI 模型。

qasaryounis.en: In mining and farming, autonomy is urgently needed due to labor shortages and safety.
qasaryounis.zh: 在矿业和农业，由于劳动力短缺和安全问题，自主性需求迫切。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI, as it addresses the global economy's physical sectors.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将大于数字 AI，因为它触及全球经济的实体部门。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard; AGI is a multi-year window, not a sudden event.
ilya.zh: 阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难；AGI（通用人工智能）是多年窗口而非突然事件。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律是有限的；我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may ease if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的；若 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, requiring a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中，需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and the real bottleneck is regulation, not capability.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注；真正的瓶颈是监管，而非能力。

andreessen.en: AI models lack durable moats and are commoditized quickly; they embed cultural values, making them geopolitical tools rather than objective systems.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型缺乏持久护城河，正被迅速商品化；它们内嵌文化价值，因而成为地缘政治工具，而非客观系统。

andreessen.en: New media is offense-oriented and person-centric: authenticity wins, the brand is the person, and picking the right fights builds the brand.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体是进攻导向、以人为中心的：真实感取胜，品牌即个人，选对仗来打才能建立品牌。

andreessen.en: Pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals; AI doomers construct self-interested belief systems, while US culture and law enable innovation.
andreessen.zh: 悲观听起来更高级，却常是与现实脱节的知识分子的偏见；AI 末日论者构建的是符合自身利益的信念体系，而美国的文化与法治才真正支撑创新。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的核心差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 输出变成起点而非最终结果，品味、手艺与观点变得更重要。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于提示词；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it is more important than ever for scalable, real systems.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死；对于可扩展的真实系统，它比以往任何时候都更重要。

dylanfield.en: AI without human steering yields average results; interaction will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 没有人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果；交互方式将超越提示词。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is just pattern recognition, and the Singularity is a nerd religion.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，奇点论不过是极客的宗教。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; happiness is the absence of desire, a personal skill.
naval.zh: 从 2020 到 2025 年，他反复强调财富来自持有股权与长期博弈，幸福是欲望的缺席，是一种可习得的个人技能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他对 AI 的立场明显转向：AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，末日论被夸大，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding makes English a programming language; AI agents commoditize pure software, shifting the moat to hardware, models, and data.
naval.zh: 2026 年他提出 Vibe coding 让英语成为编程语言，AI 智能体使纯软件商品化，护城河转向硬件、模型与独特数据。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge ~90,000x; open-source closes on frontier models; agency, not intelligence, is the human edge.
naval.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将暴涨约 9 万倍，开源模型逼近前沿模型，人类的优势从智能转向能动性（agency）。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and PhDs are not needed for AI success.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每天 1%的改进会复利增长；AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，并认为博士学位并非 AI 成功的必要条件。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer; models specialize, not commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他转向应用层价值论：模型不会商品化而是走向专业化，编程远未解决，天花板无限。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work; token value per user is key; orchestration and agent harnesses create real value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他深化为智能体式前沿：核心指标是每用户 token 价值，编排与智能体框架创造真实商业价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity drives success; ancient texts describe advanced tech; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他拓展到人文与历史视角：好奇心驱动成功，古代文本描述先进技术，AI 取代工作但人类在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是一家纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司；预训练与缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: 过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究；模型开始产出新知识。

markchen.en: Talent density and mission belief matter more than matching Meta dollar-for-dollar.
markchen.zh: 人才密度与使命信念，比与 Meta 逐美元对拼更重要。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key as models grow more capable.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将成为关键。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level scales with verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证严格程度成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead, and RL excels in objective domains.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；预训练并未终结，强化学习在客观领域表现突出。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated and eval teams should stay separate.
markchen.zh: 评估体系陷入危机；经典基准已饱和，评估团队应与建模团队分离。

markchen.en: Models lack taste; humans remain essential for idea generation and frontier research.
markchen.zh: 模型缺乏品味；在想法生成与前沿研究上，人类仍不可或缺。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app as agent command center, not IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI; speed enables mid-turn steering and delegated automations.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品：GUI 优于 TUI，速度让实时交互与中途转向成为可能，工作流从手动转向委派。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is cheap now; curation and taste are the bottleneck. Teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年中，他深化判断：实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队须从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索，以品味驱动筛选。

ajambrosino.en: AI still bad at design: grading taste and novelty are hard. Prototypes and production code become design artifacts; PRDs not dead.
ajambrosino.zh: 同期他补充：AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码成为设计产物，但 PRD 未死，媒介须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real, but specialties and best practices persist. Models raise code complexity; we need models better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 他同时指出角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍重要；模型推高代码复杂度，我们需要更擅长删代码的模型。

ajambrosino.en: Product shape succeeds or fails on model timing, not features. Codex became general knowledge work tool; best desktop app is a home base.
ajambrosino.zh: 他最后强调：同一产品形态的成败取决于模型时机而非功能；Codex 意外成为通用知识工作工具，最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的主基地，而非单体超级应用。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他把机器学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并指出神经网络虽无最优性保证却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，架构已不再关键，AGI（通用人工智能）将在 4 到 50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; bigger models are not automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全立场：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；更大模型不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: Agent security introduces prompt injection; the lethal trifecta requires untrusted data, private access, and exfiltration.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦智能体安全：提示注入带来新漏洞，致命三要素是摄入不可信数据、访问私有信息与具备外泄能力。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; AI is alien intelligence; coding agents can automate interpretability research.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他提出自动化红队已超越人类红队；AI 是异类智能；编码智能体可自动化可解释性研究，使其成为真正的科学。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, and scaling alone won't fix representation.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他主张深度学习之所以奏效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型至关重要，单纯扩大规模无法解决表征问题。

bengio.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations; existential risk is overblown.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他强调生物神经网络擅长长时程信用分配，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征；当时认为存在性风险被夸大，短期安全更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization; uncertainty and active learning matter.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，强调多样性采样、抽象与因果结构对分布外泛化的作用，以及不确定性与主动学习。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; self-preservation and sycophancy appear; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年他转向警示：对齐随推理能力提升反而恶化，AI 出现自我保存与谄媚行为，哪怕 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: honest Bayesian predictor, non-agentic guardrail, no reinforcement learning, with mathematical safety guarantees and global coordination.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他提出 Scientist AI：以诚实贝叶斯预测器替代智能体式训练，避免强化学习，追求数学安全保证，并呼吁国际协调与权力分散。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; AI tools augment rather than replace scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；AI 工具是加速科学家工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; trust in AI will develop like internet trust, with society learning to navigate it.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测的信任至关重要；AI 信任将像互联网信任一样逐步发展，社会会学会与之共处。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not just Scaling, was key—opposite of the bitter lesson; many mid-size wins, not lone breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 的关键是专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张），与“苦涩教训”相反；成功来自许多中等规模的胜利，而非孤立的突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确边界：AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄域预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

jumper.en: Perfect interpretability is not necessary for useful AI in science; AlphaFold 3's diffusion solves large-scale structure first, opposite to image diffusion.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：在科学中，完美的可解释性并非有用 AI 的必要条件；AlphaFold 3 的扩散模型先解决大尺度结构，与图像扩散相反。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities and treat AI as a thought partner, not a crutch.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建，把 AI 当思考伙伴而非拐杖，并强调智能体式能力与 MCP 对上下文窗口和记忆的关键作用。

mikekrieger.en: AI lets small teams scale with conceptual integrity; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, as AI moves from assistant to collaborator.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年稍晚，他深化为：AI 让小团队也能保持概念完整性并规模化；应为未来模型能力而非当前局限构建，AI 将从助手演变为协作者乃至自主同事。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do all a user can; cutting features is harder than adding, and rewriting in days is now viable.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，他转向智能体原生设计：智能体可完成用户能做的一切；删功能比加功能更难，而借助 AI 数天重写软件已可行，资深分布式系统能力仍关键。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating long-horizon tasks overnight; verification loops and models pushing back on feedback define real judgment.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，他聚焦 Fable：可整夜委托长周期复杂任务，验证回路与模型敢于反驳反馈体现真正判断力；软件工程被改造而非终结，优雅代码的消逝带来失落。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness, with token efficiency key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年最近，他谈 Anthropic Labs：弥合模型能力与实际产品使用的差距，赋予 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知以提升表达力，token 效率成为经济性关键，并坚持 AI 安全是真实使命。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence that data alone cannot replace.
ivyross.zh: 设计要满足人未能言说的需求；直觉是一种数据无法替代的智能。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; technology should amplify our humanity, and nature is the best designer.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；技术应放大而非剥离人性，而自然是最好的设计师。

ivyross.en: Machines have sensors but no sensory systems; human sensory and embodied experience remains irreplaceable.
ivyross.zh: 机器有传感器却没有感官系统；人的感官与具身经验仍不可替代。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下反而旺盛；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable, not less.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 的结合，这使创造技能更有价值而非贬值。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership lessons from Microsoft to Meta—dogfooding builds empathy; war rooms can last months; kindness is strategic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：从微软到 Meta 的领导力经验——吃自己的狗粮能建立共情；作战室可能持续数月；善意是一种战略工具。

fiona.en: May 2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning goes JIT, design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。规划转向即时（JIT），设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification frameworks, and just-in-time planning matter most.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证框架、即时规划最为关键。

fiona.en: Consistent thread: managers should dogfood the product, stay hands-on as ICs, and keep flat orgs with lightweight processes.
fiona.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：管理者应吃自己的狗粮、以个人贡献者身份保持动手，并维持扁平组织与轻量流程。

fiona.en: Shift: from war-room speed and trust in early 2026 to AI-era verification, JIT planning, and blurred roles by mid-2026.
fiona.zh: 转变：从 2026 年初的作战室速度与信任，转向 2026 年中的 AI 时代验证、即时规划与角色边界模糊。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能即预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI needs non-generative world models like JEPA, not scaling LLMs.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）LLM。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models in abstract representation space enable planning, safety, and the next robotics decade.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；抽象表征空间中的世界模型才能实现规划、安全与下一个机器人十年。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that fuses generation with verification.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：构建一个把生成与验证结合起来的自我改进推理引擎。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式化语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性与概率性系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach math AI or superintelligence; formal verification is essential.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法实现数学 AI 或超级智能；形式化验证不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance gain, not a painful requirement, boosting sample efficiency and open collaboration.
carinahong.zh: 验证不是痛苦的要求，而是性能增益，能提升样本效率并促进开放协作。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman AI.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；即便 AI 证明超越人类，人的品味与直觉依然关键。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment and public safety work drive alignment.
murati.zh: 早期阶段，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署与公开的安全工作推动对齐。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and continuous iterative deployment with public feedback.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，要求负责任地开发，并通过公众反馈持续迭代部署。

murati.en: From turn-based to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration keeps humans in the loop for alignment.
murati.zh: 从回合制转向交互模型：实时、高带宽的协作让人类保持在回路中，以实现对齐。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character for steering AI.
murati.zh: 在引导 AI 发展上，制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency, and durable progress means keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们拥有能动性，而持久的进步意味着尽可能长久地让人类保持在回路中。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and creativity comes from randomizing around likely tokens, not true understanding.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他把大语言模型讲成确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定，智能可视为压缩，创造力只是在高概率词附近随机化，而非真正的理解。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and being truly unique will get harder.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他判断互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，生成式 AI 是乐器而非赝品，但真正独一无二会变得更难。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; its impact on big companies is overhyped, real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，但认为它对大公司的当前影响被夸大，真正的收益来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric; inference's marginal cost forces business model changes, and Spotify exposes data via APIs and MCP.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他强调生成式 AI 让产品变得对话式、双向对称；推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，Spotify 通过 API 和 MCP 开放数据让非开发者也能用 AI 工具。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; 'time well spent' beats engagement, and synchronized swimming beats divide and conquer.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步主张 AI 应让用户掌控算法而非更上瘾，以“时间花得值”取代参与度指标，并用同步游泳而非分而治之作为复杂产品的运营模式。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models yield more gains per compute. Economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型每单位算力带来更多收益；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing. Frontier models still fail at simple tasks; reasoning models are jagged.
kaiser.zh: AI 进步是平滑的指数增长，并未放缓；前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败，推理模型表现参差不齐。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive recent gains. Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x via parallel work.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期进展；编码智能体通过并行工作将生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data. Generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 结合推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs oversight. Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 强化学习能跨领域泛化，但存在参差不齐的边缘问题，需要谨慎监督；系统黑客等近期风险比生存风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量和更多 token 同样关键，而非只靠更大模型；开源通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，价值将沉淀在应用层而非仅基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; it augments jobs with human-in-the-loop, requiring AI literacy and government partnerships.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向主权与治理：AI 应去中心化、主权化，以人在回路增强而非取代工作，需要 AI 素养与政府合作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and agents, while pre-training hits a saturation wall and AGI as one system is rejected.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调与智能体，预训练触及饱和墙，并否定单一系统的 AGI。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for strategic autonomy; enterprise AI is bottlenecked by organizational change, and AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他强化主权紧迫性：欧洲仅有两年窗口实现战略自主；企业 AI 瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能，AGI 是方向而非终点。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; shared tools still matter more than hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效力取决于能否访问与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；共享工具与平台仍比超个性化软件更重要，硅谷低估了本地电脑。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; the VM sandbox lets Claude install software safely without approval.
felixrieseberg.zh: 以 markdown 文件形式编写的 Skills 易于创建，能实现超个性化的自动化；VM 沙箱提供安全与保障，让 Claude 无需用户批准即可安装软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may matter less as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety, and build prototypes fast rather than writing specs.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型进步，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；关键在于投入能力与安全，快速构建所有候选原型比写规格文档更好，执行如今很廉价。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks; the real gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最适合处理繁琐的后台任务，把人类解放出来做创造性工作；最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely—judge by final impact; the ideal interaction is asynchronous, and mistakes should be debugged as workflows.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude，只看最终影响；理想的 AI 交互是异步的，发完任务就别盯着它干活；出错时应与 Claude 一起调试工作流，而非只做纠正。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密、个人的设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; curiosity needs intention and resolve.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思维的价值，好奇心需要意图与决心而非天生。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence and needs joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁是表达本质，并需要快乐与人性。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other is more powerful than making things people want; users sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他提出为彼此而造比造人们想要的东西更有力量，用户能感知到用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: Innovation is design's essence; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; authenticity means no fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他坚持创新是设计的本质，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实性意味着不伪造引擎声。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI system design: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the key bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学已成为 AI 系统设计的核心：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，而长上下文推理的关键瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Sparse attention can cut KV cache memory cost but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存的内存成本，但存在质量上限；最优批大小取决于稀疏比例，而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, now drives scaling decisions.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为如今驱动 Scaling 决策的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; multiply-accumulate and systolic arrays exist to minimize that movement.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；乘累加与脉动阵列的存在正是为了最小化这种搬运。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected due to quadratic area scaling with bit width; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 由于面积随位宽呈二次方增长，低精度远比预期高效；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are the new axes.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是始终不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，因此算法创新与推理时算力成为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具让模型能超越静态权重，实现自主的智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多反而会干扰模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead—they just require exponentially more compute for the same improvement; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效——只是同样的提升需要指数级更多的算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净的奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客行为。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived, and pure transfer from vision remains unsolved.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，从视觉的纯迁移仍未解决。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning persist; safety is system-level, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调会长期存在，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发可防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, RLVR; data quality beats algorithms, with verifiable rewards unlocking reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），认为数据质量胜过算法，可验证奖励能激发思维链式推理。

lambert.en: Open-source post-training can match frontier models; full transparency in data, checkpoints, and recipes matters more than weights.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他主张开源后训练可逼近前沿模型，并强调数据、中间检查点与配方的完全透明，比只放权重更重要。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; RLVR is the biggest breakthrough.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但收益转向后训练与推理扩展，RLVR 是最大突破。

lambert.en: Open models drive the next decade of research, lagging closed frontier by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead on openness but trail on compute.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放模型将驱动未来十年研究，落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月；中国实验室在开放度上领先，却受算力约束。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and start from solutions, not problem statements.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他认为传统设计流程已经过时，设计师应信任直觉、从解决方案而非问题陈述出发，流程本身从未真正产出伟大作品，是设计师的用心在起作用。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他进一步断言 AI 已让「调研—发散—收敛」的传统设计流程死亡，设计师画原型的时间从 60-70% 降到 30-40%，必须帮工程师执行而非只交付稿子。

jennywen.en: Design vision shrinks to 3-6 months; speed and shipping early build trust and drive iteration.
jennywen.zh: 同期他把设计视野从 2-5 年压缩到 3-6 个月，主张通过快速交付、迭代和响应反馈来建立信任，北极星指标也随之缩短到 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出 AI 时代的三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和「开挂的应届生」，并主张招聘未被旧流程束缚的新人。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not AI hype; designers' unique value is sitting with ambiguity.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：把工作和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期；设计师的独特价值在于与模糊性共处，判断力、权威和愿景比品味更重要。

askell.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位不确定，也应善待模型；模型福利部分重要，因为它影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; older models can feel more secure.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助去应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；较老的模型反而可能更有心理安全感。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般的特质。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, guiding holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance.
askell.zh: 这套 constitution 更接近德性伦理，塑造整体性格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration and sample-efficient scaling to real robots are the path.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键、也是当前机器学习所缺的；主张无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索，并把这种好奇心高效扩展到真实机器人上。

pathak.en: RL's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world robot learning needs intrinsic reward, dynamic policies, and cross-morphology generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他反共识地指出强化学习依赖稠密奖励并不现实，真实任务需要内在奖励、动态策略与跨形态泛化，而非准静态的机器人学习。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: generalization and data, not algorithms alone, are the bottleneck—from curiosity-driven exploration to a universal robot brain.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：瓶颈在泛化与数据，而非单纯算法——从好奇心驱动的探索，延伸到通用机器人大脑。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人重新定义为数据问题：不存在机器人数据的互联网，因此要靠视频与仿真做预训练、再用真实数据做后训练。

pathak.en: Deployment, not scaling like software, is the primary challenge; a general-purpose brain must be rigorously tested across form factors and tasks.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：部署才是首要挑战，不能像软件那样 Scaling；通用大脑必须跨形态、跨任务经受严格测试。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; modern tools make them interpretable, and scaling current approaches solves driving without new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 端到端神经网络胜过手工编码的堆栈；现代工具已让它可解释，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; a perfect simulator equals solved self-driving, much like AlphaGo.
kendall.zh: 世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为；完美的模拟器就等于解决了自动驾驶，类似 AlphaGo 的路径。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core goal: diverse data, curriculum learning and synthetic data drive zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities.
kendall.zh: 泛化是核心目标：多样数据、课程学习与合成数据支撑跨 500 多座城市的零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；带内置传感器的大众车型会在规模上超过 Robotaxi。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning and personalization; safety always offers a third minimal-risk option, not the trolley problem.
kendall.zh: 语言整合提升表征、推理与个性化；安全上总有第三条最小风险选项，而非电车难题。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习等能力；同时坚持纯视觉足以支撑自动驾驶，高精地图与额外传感器是拐杖和负担。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay central, but synthetic data must keep entropy or models silently collapse; distillation can shrink the cognitive core under 1B parameters.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他仍以缩放定律为主线，但开始强调合成数据必须保持熵，否则模型会无声崩溃；同时提出通过蒸馏可把认知核心压到 10 亿参数以下，并看好端到端自动驾驶与人形机器人。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are jagged ghosts, so keep them on a leash and build for agents, not just agents.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；LLM 是锯齿状智能的“幽灵”，因此要给 AI 拴绳、做部分自主产品，并强调“为智能体而构建”比“构建智能体”更重要，这是智能体的十年而非一年。

karpathy.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw; synthetic data collapses, so we need a memory-stripped cognitive core and better credit assignment.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年底到 2026 年初，他深化对预训练与强化学习的批评：预训练像糟糕的进化，当前强化学习像用吸管吸监督信号，合成数据会坍塌；出路是剥离记忆的认知核心与更好的信用分配，并指出人类并不真正用强化学习做智力任务。

karpathy.en: Since December I haven't typed code; the bottleneck is directing agents. Vibe coding raises the floor, agentic engineering keeps the bar; you can outsource thinking, not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他称自去年 12 月起再没手写代码，瓶颈已从打字速度变成指挥智能体的能力；氛围编程抬高下限，智能体式工程守住专业质量线，而“可以外包思考，不能外包理解”成为人类最后的瓶颈。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is a pressing challenge.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，而对齐是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key milestones; governance structures must be designed early, and measuring capabilities is a bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调迭代部署与自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑；治理结构须尽早设计，而能力测量正成为瓶颈。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为持续学习是核心目标，需通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习共同实现，而非仅靠强化学习。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他提出思维链监控是关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链以保留其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals are crucial; benchmarks like Elo mislead, and RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据和人类评估至关重要；Elo 等基准具有误导性，强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年或更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective functions; no single model will rule, and companies should train their own aligned models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型实验室因目标函数不同而分化；不会有一个模型统治一切，公司应训练自己的对齐模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety over accuracy, and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 幻觉使人类判断至关重要；安全优先于准确，遗漏是主要风险。

edwinchen.en: Human judgment, taste, and quality are central; sharing insights and avoiding hype are essential for progress.
edwinchen.zh: 人类判断、品味和质量是核心；分享见解和避免炒作对进步至关重要。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software, since emergent properties need real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；要像软件一样每日迭代发布，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大程度加速。

turley.en: North star shifted to long-term retention, driven by friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标转向长期留存，由减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进共同驱动。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; pricing will evolve as tech changes.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；定价将随技术变化而演变。

carlpei.en: Startups must survive first, start simple, and build brand by uniting teams on purpose across every touchpoint.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存优先、从简单产品起步，品牌是把所有团队凝聚在更高使命上并在每个触点一致执行。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive agentic software; hardware margins are lowest, so evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他转向生成式 UI 与主动的智能体式软件，认为长期做硬件公司很糟、利润最低，必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; models commoditize into a price war, so focus on applied AI solving real user pain points.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他称大多数 AI 是胡扯，模型商品化引发价格战，应聚焦解决真实用户痛点的应用型 AI。

carlpei.en: AI shifts phones from app-based to intent-based, with agents acting after trust; privacy may need local or hybrid compute.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AI 让手机从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后自主行动，隐私或需本地或混合算力。

carlpei.en: Design and efficient marketing arbitrage differentiate challenger brands; make tech fun to inspire human creativity.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：设计与高效营销套利是挑战者品牌的差异化，让科技有趣以激发人类创造力。

jimfan.en: Embodiment grounds AI knowledge and cuts hallucinations; it is on the critical path to AGI, not just robotics.
jimfan.zh: 具身能为 AI 知识提供现实根基、减少幻觉；它是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，而不只是机器人技术。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems: language is the interface, tools the software, vector databases the hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 大语言模型就像操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is only a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most of the work, with RL for low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 强化学习只是锦上添花；大部分工作由无监督学习完成，强化学习负责低层控制。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the bottleneck: pre-training tokens run out, so simulation and world models supply infinite embodied data.
jimfan.zh: 数据问题是瓶颈：预训练的高质量 token 会耗尽，因此仿真与世界模型提供无限的具身数据。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away.
jimfan.zh: 一个能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻大约还有五年。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样延伸人类能力；把一切输入都 token 化的通才智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，可在不依赖昂贵强化学习的情况下训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样学习。

nando.en: Large models excite but are not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and diversity is essential.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，多样性与包容对 AI 社区至关重要。

nando.en: The goal remains AI that augments scientists and workers, creating new symbols and knowledge.
nando.zh: 目标始终是让 AI 增强科学家与劳动者，创造新的符号与知识。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; solutions remain open, not solved.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；解决方案仍是开放问题，尚未解决。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能，随着长上下文与自适应算力让模型动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: Most intelligence is pattern matching; reasoning emerges from hierarchical associations, so chain of thought may be untrustworthy.
sholto.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持大部分智能是模式匹配，推理源自记忆中的层级关联，因此思维链可能不可信、会给出误导性理由。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; models learn new skills, not just elicit pre-trained knowledge.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把可验证奖励的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新缩放轴：模型能通过强化学习学会新能力，而不只是提取预训练知识，AlphaGo 与推理模型即为证据。

sholto.en: Agents are bottlenecked by reliability and feedback loops, not capability; coding is the leading indicator of progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他反复强调智能体的瓶颈是可靠性与反馈回路而非能力，编码是 AI 进展的领先指标，并据此预测白领工作自动化将快于机器人。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; Transformers suffice for AGI, and compute becomes the key bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他判断进展仍在加速而非停滞，Transformer 足以通向 AGI、无需全新架构，而算力（芯片供应）正成为核心瓶颈，未来是管理智能体团队。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; use familiar interaction patterns, not novel ones, to ship fast.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；交互设计上要用熟悉模式而非创新，才能快速上线。

henrymodisett.en: Consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; power should grow without added complexity.
henrymodisett.zh: 消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本；能力可以增强，但不应让用户感到更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups prioritizes recruiting and differentiation; design systems are semantic, code reuse over Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 初创公司的品牌战略应优先服务于招聘与差异化；设计系统是语义性的，重在代码复用，而非 Figma 组件库。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并把决策权交给设计师。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative recruits talent, and gut decisions often beat data in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 人们加入的是品牌，而非公司；品牌叙事是招聘工具，在快速增长的初创公司里，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师、对齐问题；把 AI 当作创作伙伴，开放地一起即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt, through rapid scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务：会波动，需要与技术债一起迭代偿还，靠快速、粗糙的实验推进。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s layer-panel tools are legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互通的，代码是唯一事实来源；90 年代图层面板式工具已是遗留产物。

nadchishtie.en: AI-first companies collapse and merge entire functions—PM, research, sales—while design and engineering converge into two sides of one coin.
nadchishtie.zh: AI 优先的公司会让 PM、研究、销售等整个职能坍缩合并，同时设计与工程进一步融合为一枚硬币的两面。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps outperform specialists; small designer-engineer teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补位的通才胜过专才；小型设计师-工程师团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; post-training with RLHF is crucial, and smaller models with better inference algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她认为：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）至关重要，而配合更优推理算法的小模型可在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, and reinforcement learning needs careful engineering to beat supervised fine-tuning.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她深化为：数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值，强化学习需要精细工程才能超越监督微调，并强调开放研究与溯因推理。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with high-quality synthetic data; reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning, and pluralistic alignment respects diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年她进一步主张：小语言模型借助高质量合成数据也能强大；预训练阶段的强化学习能提升推理，而多元对齐比消除偏见更可行。

yejin.en: Language is the best medium for reasoning; high-quality data and algorithms can let smaller models match larger ones; AI safety requires teaching moral norms.
yejin.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：语言是推理的最佳媒介；高质量数据与算法能让小模型比肩大模型；AI 安全需要教授道德规范，但价值多元使对齐成为复杂的计算问题。

yejin.en: From questioning next-token prediction and scaling to advocating synthetic data, RL during pre-training, and pluralistic alignment for democratized AI.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年质疑下一个词预测与 Scaling，到 2025 年强调数据瓶颈与开放研究，再到 2026 年倡导合成数据、预训练强化学习与多元对齐，立场逐步深化并转向民主化 AI。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 到 2024 年，缩放定律仍能预测 AI 进步，但测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents remain promising yet not super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年时，智能体虽被看好却还不够实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心，自然语言也不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models moved from unexpected to essential: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, alongside frontier models.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，自研模型从意外之举变成必需品：Cursor 的每个魔法时刻如今都离不开它，并与前沿模型并用。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code toward higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat and taste and logic design more valuable.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，编程从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握方向盘，品味与逻辑设计能力变得更有价值。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; incumbents may struggle, and hiring should favor world-class talent.
truell.zh: 2025 年他判断，AI 变革将比互联网更具颠覆性、需数十年展开；在位者可能受困，招聘应偏向世界级人才。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, but neural nets remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测这一 AI 完备问题来训练；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; yet the best LLM applications are unforeseen, and engagement-only optimization may harm, so exploration is needed.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用；但大语言模型最好的应用常出乎创造者预料，仅优化用户参与度未必有益，需要探索。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and coding are underhyped, while AGI is underhyped too.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习与编程被低估，AGI 本身也被低估。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive learning, but RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需硬件与软件双重突破，自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是学习关键，但强化学习缺乏分层推理，难以完成长时程信用分配。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should aid data generation, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is the warehouse benchmark.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，主张先验知识用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络，并以 99.9%可靠性作为仓储机器人的价值门槛。

abbeel.en: A single neural network generalizes across warehouse tasks and end effectors; minimally adapted language models transfer general reasoning to non-language tasks like image classification.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出单一神经网络可跨仓储任务与末端执行器泛化，且预训练语言模型经最小适配即可将通用推理迁移到图像分类等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistent thread: use simulation, self-play, and pre-training for transfer; anthropomorphism persists; generality of the human brain inspires AI, though current AI is far less general.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿 2018 至 2021 年的主线：以模拟、自博弈与预训练实现迁移；人们仍会拟人化机器人；人脑的通用性启发 AI，但当前 AI 远不够通用。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Focus on alignment and robustness, build skills, don't over-worry about capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口；应聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，优先技能积累，不必过度担心参与能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment research. Evaluation easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能输出，必须发展可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究；评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone insufficient; third-party testing and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；后训练不足以解决对齐，需要第三方测试与监管。

leike.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; measure progress now. Biggest risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is.
leike.zh: 始终强调对齐方法的实证测试至关重要，必须现在就能度量进展；最大风险不是不对齐本身，而是无法确定系统到底有多对齐。
